payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW did not converge. The primary review found three critical correctness/security/contract blockers and three package/CLI nits. Antigravity, Claude, and Grok timed out and Pi returned invalid JSON, so external quorum was 0/4; the single-vendor consensus artifact is explicitly non-quorate and its automatic zero-blocking summary must not override the primary critical findings.
completed_work: Read proposal, design, tasks, all delta specs, contracts, and work-packages.yaml.
Wrote and schema-validated 8 Codex findings: 3 critical, 3 nit, and 2 positive observations.
Dispatched plan review to Antigravity, Claude, Grok, and Pi and recorded every failure in review-manifest.json.
Synthesized consensus-plan.json from the only valid review; quorum was not met and all findings remain unconfirmed.

decisions.title: Plan review is not converged
decisions.rationale: Abrupt expiry and session release can leave unknown checkout state automatically adoptable, v1 synthetic lease migration is incomplete, and multi-vendor quorum was lost.

next_steps: Specify atomic expired-lease takeover so dirty, non-durable, or indeterminate state is quarantined before ordinary acquisition.
Make session-end release quarantine or safely dispose preserved state instead of creating an idle adoptable checkout.
Define every required synthetic lease field and exact legacy heartbeat migration behavior.
Add omitted package-owned shared lifecycle tests and the coordinator Docker import test to package scope and verification.
Clarify absent-release and repeated-teardown idempotency, then rerun multi-vendor PLAN_REVIEW.
